messages:
Riley: Quick check  I have 11h PTO left and there's a company-wide blackout Jan 10-14. My manager Cam is traveling. Can I request 8h carryover + payout 3h?
Cam: I'm on a timezone hop but I can approve the 8h carryover + payout 3h. Posting approval here so BambooHR picks it up.
Harper (People Ops): Thanks  two small items: (1) we need manager approval in BambooHR or a delegation statement in-thread, (2) please submit CE-5012 with attached BambooHR approval before payroll cutoff 2026-01-05 02:00 UTC.
Riley: Cam, I'll wait for you to add the BambooHR approval then I'll file CE-5012.
Cam: Added approval in BambooHR: "approve 8h carryover + payout 3h for Riley" (2025-12-30T18:40Z).
BambooHR Bot: Manager approval recorded: Cam approved carryover 8h + payout 3h for Riley on 2025-12-30T18:40:12Z.
Riley: Submitted CE-5012: reason="year-end overflow; manager approved" and attached BambooHR screenshot.
People Ops Bot: CE-5012 received. Note: non-medical >8h requires People Ops sign-off. Reviewing now.
Payroll Bot: CE-5012 acknowledged. If paperwork complete before cutoff 2026-01-05 02:00 UTC, payout will be included in the Jan payroll run. Otherwise it will be deferred. Payroll will post confirmation here after processing.
Riley: One more thing  will payout change my tax withholding for Jan?
Harper: Payout is taxed as supplemental wages. It may change net pay for that period. For options to split payout across two pay periods, file CE-5012 with note "split requested" and we'll see if we can schedule.
Riley: No split needed. Thanks for the quick help.
People Ops Bot: Thread status: awaiting payroll finalization for CE-5012. Will update when payroll posts confirmation.
